goal: Allow external wallets and indexers to manually lock block heights against pruning
Prevent unloaded wallets from losing blocks required for rescans on pruned nodes
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with nothing blocking review
agreement: Strong support for allowing external tooling and wallets to run on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v)
Verified by testing with electrs indexer on a pruned signet node (optout21)
Unaddressed suggestion on lock name ':' character restrictions and error messaging (andrewtoth)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds RPC controls explicitly needed by external indexers and wallets on pruned nodes
Prevents blocks needed for rescans from being pruned away while preserving automatic pruning

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it exposes block storage prune lock control without touching core consensus logic
Affects only block file retention accounting rather than chainstate validation
